description.short: Facilitated design-thinking workshops in your Teams channel.
description.full: Run collaborative MightShape exercises in a standard Microsoft Teams channel. One member starts a workshop by mentioning MightShape; teammates explicitly opt in through a private contribution dialog; the initiator freezes or closes the exercise; and the openly disclosed AI facilitator posts a source-linked visual plus an accessible text summary back to the same thread. Team input remains USER_PROVIDED design material and is never mislabeled as human-research evidence.

features.title: Collaborative workshops
features.description: Run structured brainstorms, affinity clustering, process mapping, and assumption mapping in a channel thread.

features.title: Protected participation
features.description: Use private dialogs for explicit opt-in input and sealed divergence before synthesis.

features.title: Visual synthesis
features.description: Receive a whimsical source-linked PNG plus an accessible text summary in the workshop thread.
